title: Consolidate duplicated COSE_ALG_LABEL/COSE_KID_LABEL constants (4 modules)
description: Left out of scope of project-LICHEN-worker6-r18i: COSE_ALG_LABEL = 1 and COSE_KID_LABEL = 4 are defined independently in python/src/lichen/crypto/{capability_announcements,delegation_tokens,key_rotation_attestation,root_dio_signature}.py.
